summary: Iteration 67: Notification Preferences Feature Testing - ALL FEATURES WORKING. Backend: 14/14 tests passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified for both vendor and admin dashboards. Gear icon visible, preferences panel shows all 6 event types + 2 sound toggles, toggle functionality works, Done button closes panel.

VERIFIED: PUT /api/notifications/vendor/preferences updates specific prefs and returns full updated prefs
VERIFIED: GET /api/notifications/admin/preferences works with admin token
VERIFIED: PUT /api/notifications/admin/preferences works with admin token
VERIFIED: Default preferences: all event types ON, sound_high ON, sound_medium OFF
VERIFIED: Empty body PUT returns 400 error
VERIFIED: Preferences persist across requests (saved in notification_prefs collection)
VERIFIED: Backend respects preferences - when credit type disabled, no credit notification created
VERIFIED: When credit type enabled, credit notification IS created
VERIFIED: Auth required for all preference endpoints (401/403 without token)
VERIFIED: Frontend gear icon visible in notification dropdown header
VERIFIED: Frontend preferences panel shows all 6 event types with toggles
VERIFIED: Frontend preferences panel shows 2 sound toggles (high/medium priority)
VERIFIED: Frontend toggle click updates preference via API (optimistic update)
VERIFIED: Frontend Done button closes preferences panel
seed_data_creation: Credit notifications created via POST /api/admin/master/action/add-credits/VND-0001 for preference enforcement testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notification preferences feature fully working. Endpoints: GET/PUT /api/notifications/vendor/preferences and GET/PUT /api/notifications/admin/preferences. Preferences stored in notification_prefs collection. Backend checks prefs at top of create_notification() and skips if type disabled. WebSocket payload includes play_sound field based on sound_high/sound_medium prefs. Frontend uses optimistic updates with rollback on error. Razorpay and Instagram Auto-DMs are MOCKED.
